landing_sign_in_status: Sign-in with Plex is being rebuilt. Your recap is visible to server members only.
error_access_denied_description: The request was refused because it didn't come from this site.
error_access_denied_proxy_description: The request didn't come through the proxy {{name}} expects.
error_too_many_attempts_one: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count, number}} minute. Behind a reverse proxy, set ADDRESS_HEADER so each visitor is counted apart.
error_too_many_attempts_other: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count, number}} minutes. Behind a reverse proxy, set ADDRESS_HEADER so each visitor is counted apart.
error_server_busy: {{name}} is busy checking other passwords. Try again in a few seconds.
error_no_browser_address: Your browser didn't say which address it is using. Set ORIGIN and restart {{name}}.
error_forbidden_description: You don't have access to this page.
error_not_found_description: This page doesn't exist, or it has moved.
error_too_many_requests_description: Too many requests came from your address. Wait a moment, then try again.
setup_intro: Enter the setup token printed in the server console, then create the owner account.
setup_token_help_one: Shown as {{format}}. A new one is printed every {{count, number}} minute.
setup_token_help_other: Shown as {{format}}. A new one is printed every {{count, number}} minutes.
setup_token_refused: That setup token isn't valid. Use the newest one printed in the server console.
setup_username_control: Leave out line breaks and tabs.
setup_password_pattern: This password is a simple pattern. Choose another.
setup_password_common: This password is on a list of common passwords. Choose another.
setup_failed: {{name}} couldn't create the owner account. Try again with the newest setup token from the server console.
sign_in_forgot_restart: Set {{variable}} in the environment and restart {{name}}.
sign_in_forgot_token: Copy the recovery token printed in the server console.
sign_in_forgot_recovery: Open {{path}} and set a new password.
error_session_ended_description: Your session ended. Sign in again.
security_password_changed: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.
security_sessions_count_one: Signed in on {{count, number}} other browser.
security_sessions_count_other: Signed in on {{count, number}} other browsers.
security_sessions_none: No other browser is signed in.
security_sessions_ended_one: Signed out of {{count, number}} other browser.
security_sessions_ended_other: Signed out of {{count, number}} other browsers.
security_recovery_on: Recovery is on. Remove {{variable}} from the environment and restart {{name}}.
recovery_intro: Enter the recovery token printed in the server console, then set a new password. Every session ends.
recovery_token_help: Shown as {{format}}. Restart {{name}} for a new one.
recovery_token_refused: That recovery token isn't valid. Use the one printed in the server console, or restart {{name}} for a new one.
recovery_failed: {{name}} couldn't set the new password. Restart it for a new recovery token, then try again.
